query:
SELECT 'inadimplencia' as fonte, COUNT(*) as total, 
  ROUND(SUM(valorLiquido), 2) as valor_liquido,
  ROUND(SUM(valorOriginal), 2) as valor_original
FROM accounts_receivable 
WHERE estado = 'EMITIDO' AND vencimentoData < CURDATE()
AND tipo IN ('TITULO', 'RECEITA', 'ADIANTAMENTO')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'planilha' as fonte, COUNT(*) as total, 
  ROUND(SUM(valor), 2) as valor_liquido,
  0 as valor_original
FROM cobranca_planilha;
